rationale: Builds directly on the current best late-aligned recurrent-tail script. The only functional change is to store each tail block's first-pass delta and feed a half-gated copy of that delta into the matching recurrent replay, reusing the existing recurrence gates instead of adding a new parameter family. This probes a new local carryover mechanism without spending the run on another small optimizer sweep or a larger head branch. AST parse passes and the script stays at 1496 lines.
title: First-Pass Tail Delta Replay On Late-Aligned Skips
